examples.description: Import a seeded fixture message attributed to an external sender
examples.command: aclif google gmail import --from "aisha.patel@example.com" --to "demo@example.com" --subject "Q2 review followup" --body "Looking forward to it."

examples.description: Import a backdated message with a pre-set Message-ID for deterministic threading
examples.command: aclif google gmail import --from "ben.rivera@example.com" --to "demo@example.com" --subject "Renewal timing" --body "..." --date "Mon, 03 Mar 2026 09:00:00 +0000" --message-id "story6.001@example.com"

examples.description: Import a reply that threads against a prior imported message
examples.command: aclif google gmail import --from "aisha.patel@example.com" --to "demo@example.com" --subject "Re: Q2 review followup" --body "Sounds good." --in-reply-to "story6.001@example.com" --references "story6.001@example.com"

examples.description: Import a fixture message with a PDF attachment and a user-visible label
examples.command: aclif google gmail import --from "maria.vasquez@example.com" --to "hiring@example.com" --subject "Application for Vineyard Production Manager" --body "Cover letter…" --attachment ./fixtures/resume.pdf --label-names "candidate"
